Tells whether a key is held down right now. Keys are named by their scancode, which is the position of the key on the keyboard and does not change with the keyboard layout. Some of them: Escape 1, the digit row 2 to 11, Backspace 14, Tab 15, Enter 28, left Ctrl 29, left Shift 42, right Shift 54, left Alt 56, Space 57, F1 to F10 59 to 68, F11 87, F12 88, Up 200, Left 203, Right 205, Down 208, Insert 210 and Delete 211. The letter keys follow the top left to bottom right order of a US keyboard, so Q is 16, A is 30 and Z is 44.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local x = 160, y = 120
While Not KeyDown(1)
	If KeyDown(203) Then x = x - 2
	If KeyDown(205) Then x = x + 2
	If KeyDown(200) Then y = y - 2
	If KeyDown(208) Then y = y + 2
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Arrow keys move the box, Escape ends"
	Rect x - 8, y - 8, 16, 16, 1
	Flip
Wend
```
@param key  The scancode of the key, 1 to 255.
@param device  Only look at this keyboard, counted from 0 as in KeyboardDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all keyboards together.
@returns 1 while the key is held down, otherwise 0.
@gap Keys that have no scancode in the original table, such as Pause, Print Screen, the Windows keys and F13 and above, are never reported as pressed.
@gap Without an open graphics window nothing can be pressed, and the function returns 0.
@gap The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one keyboard.
